version_metadata.description:
FloraFinder AI is your advanced botanical companion, powered by Google Gemini multimodal intelligence and on-device vision.

Key Features:
• High-Precision Species Identification: Point your camera at any flower, orchid, houseplant, tree, or leaf to identify exact botanical species (e.g. Phalaenopsis orchid, Ficus elastica), binomial nomenclature, family, and genus.
• Plant Doctor & Pathology Rx: Diagnose plant diseases, leaf spot pathogens, fungal infections, and nutrient deficiencies. Receive instant organic and chemical recovery regimens.
• Complete Horticultural Care: Master sunlight requirements, watering cycles, soil composition, and explicit pet toxicity safety warnings for dogs and cats.
• Botanical Specimen Logbook: Keep a persistent journal of all your scanned plants with search, date stamps, and health status indicators.
version_metadata.promotional_text: High-precision plant identification, botanical specimen logbook, and deep AI disease diagnostics.

app_review_information.review_notes: FloraFinder AI uses Google Gemini multimodal intelligence for precise species identification and disease pathology diagnosis. No login or demo account is required to access all features.
